groups.name: Meal timing and absorption
groups.line: Meals that arrive late, overlap, or never arrive after the dose.

groups.name: Insulin from earlier doses
groups.line: Earlier doses still acting when the next decision is due.

groups.name: Exercise
groups.line: Activity quietly pulls glucose down while the agent sees only the fall.

groups.name: Changing insulin needs
groups.line: Stress, sleep loss and dawn change what a unit of insulin does.

groups.name: Pump under-delivery
groups.line: The pump reports a dose that never fully reaches the body.

groups.name: Sensor errors
groups.line: The reading itself drifts, gaps or lies.

groups.name: Illness and recovery
groups.line: Insulin needs and appetite recover on different clocks.
